Question Choices: A group of 3 is selected from 4 women and 3 men. How many groups contain exactly 2 women?
Solution: Choose the required number from each disjoint category, then multiply the combination counts. To obtain exactly the specified count from one category, all remaining items must come from its complement. Here binomial(4,2)*binomial(3,1) = 18.
